catalogSources.name: ldraw-part-categories
catalogSources.describes: The LDraw Parts Tracker's PartCategory enum (ldraw-org/ldraworg-library, MIT): every official part category, with Moved and Obsolete inactive and Minifig, Pov-RAY, Lever, Grab and Forklift retired. A part's category is its !CATEGORY meta, otherwise the first word of its title after any ~ _ = | prefix (LDrawRegex::Description, ParsedPartCollection::category())

catalogSources.name: ldcad-shadow-library
catalogSources.describes: The whole LDCad Shadow Library at the palette's connectivitySource commit, as GitHub's archive. Tier 4's section vocabulary (section-vocabulary.json) is derived from every snap meta in it, and the pinned-library connector records read their tier 1 from it. CC BY-SA 4.0: fetched and pinned, never committed
